name: Jiwon Hur
summary: A longtime reader and writer, now working on a young adult romance novel. She started Herbart Kita for writers like her high school self.
bio: Jiwon is a longtime reader and a passionate writer. In high school, the work she cared about most kept getting dismissed as “by a kid.” Herbart Kita grew out of that: a publisher that reads young writers the way it would read anyone else.
She is writing a young adult romance novel.

name: Seong Won Choi
summary: Author of two books in An Irreverent Guide to the DSAT series, now writing AP US History and AP World History in the same satirical style.
bio: Under the name Kevin Choi, Seong Won is the author of two books in An Irreverent Guide to the DSAT series.
Now writing new books for AP US History and AP World History in the same satirical, irreverent style.
